title: Playboy: Women of Color
overview: They're exciting, exotic and absolutely alluring they're Playboy's Women of Color. Hosted by 1990 Playmate of the Year Renee Tenison (the first African American woman to capture the coveted title), this special showcases with pride the ethnic, beauty that makes these women some of the most vibrant and radiant in the world. Join Renee as she introduces her Playmate girl- friends, each having ancestral spirit and a sense of style and soul that's all her own. You'll fly high with gorgeous flight attendant Lorraine Olivia, and luxuriate in a waterfall oasis with Jamaican born lovely Venice Kong. Then, it's time for spontaneous fun with West Indian, Cherokee and Irish stunner Stephanie Adams, and relaxing moments from Reneé. Plus, indulge in a variety of erotic fantasies for you and your lover to share. Color your world with Playboy Women of Color and enjoy the sensual celebration.
